Panoramas of one pure-rotation sweep per lens (Tamron 20\,mm lens at $f/2.8$ and Sigma 14\,mm lens at $f/4$), composed by our stack's own panorama stage, which samples every pixel of the panorama through the calibrated camera, without feature registration and without blending. Left: the frames as they are. Right: the same frames with our learned vignetting divided out. All panels are drawn with the same display curve (gain 4, gamma 2.2).
